## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem, what changes for a user or agent, and any related issue. Keep the scope small.

## Validation

List commands and results, plus relevant checks that could not run. Behavior changes need a meaningful regression and focused/core tests. Docs-only changes can use link and example checks.

## Visual or data evidence, when relevant

Show a small before/after comparison with exact IDs and settings. Distinguish measured checks from design judgment, and supervised reference recovery from the original semantic query. Preserve failures, ties, and historical records.

## Review readiness

- [ ] No font binaries/archives, model weights, catalogs/indexes, credentials, or private project data are included.
- [ ] Source pins and provenance are preserved; rights or performance claims match the evidence.
- [ ] I reviewed [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/gavinjudd/type-evidence/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md), including the separate harness and third-party licensing terms.
